vulnerabilities.description: PHPUnit before 10.5.38 contains an unsafe PHPT coverage deserialization and environment-variable command injection sink when invoked with coverage options in CI runners.
pytest-cov-bridge 1.4.2 passes unvalidated environment variables and coverage report filenames to a shell subprocess during XML coverage aggregation.

sast_cicd_findings.title: Dangerous Workflow: Untrusted Code Checkout on pull_request_target with Secrets Access
sast_cicd_findings.snippet: on: [pull_request_target] ... uses: actions/checkout@v4 with: ref: ${{ github.event.pull_request.head.sha }}
sast_cicd_findings.remediation_guidance: Do not check out untrusted PR head refs inside a pull_request_target workflow, or isolate build/test execution in an unprivileged pull_request workflow without secrets.
